description: Create a secure checkout for a chosen hotel room and return a getmyhotels.com URL where the guest completes payment. This does NOT charge the card — the guest pays on the hosted page. Confirm the hotel, room, dates, and price with the user before calling. Call `get_checkout_quote` first to confirm the live price.

price.description: Total to charge for the WHOLE stay (use `grandTotal` from `get_checkout_quote` verbatim — do not multiply it by the number of nights).

ref.description: Hotel `ref` from `search_hotels` (e.g. 'TBO:1402689'). Alternative to supplierCode + supplierHotelId.

supplierCode.description: Supplier code (from `search_hotels`). Required if `ref` is omitted.

supplierHotelId.description: Supplier hotel id (from `search_hotels`). Required if `ref` is omitted.

supplierRoomId.description: Bookable room/rate id from the chosen room in `search_hotels`.

name: create_checkout
title: Create checkout
